title: ServingFile
description: One content-addressed file under data/serve/ (ADR-098, docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md section 21): the player-name dictionary, a slice (one column-major table of one artifact's records for one partition) or a card shard (one table per artifact for one block and player bucket). Every table decodes to exactly the matching records of its source artifact; the validator proves it.

absent.description: Field -> indices of rows that do not carry the field at all (distinct from a null).

envelope.description: Fields every row takes from the source artifact's envelope in the manifest (build identity).

names.description: The field every row takes from the player dictionary by player_id.

nested.description: Field -> the key tree its object values share; each leaf is served as the column `<field>.<key>...`.

constants.description: Field or leaf path -> the one value every row holds.

columns.description: Field or leaf path -> one value per row.

join.description: Rows marked 1 take `fields` from the row of the same player in the named family's slice of the same partition, which the validator proves equal.
